text:
Situation: As of 2026-10-21, amlodipine besylate 5 mg tablets are not on the FDA drug shortage list. Corvale East holds 155 tablets (14.2 days on hand at 10.9 tablets per day). Corvale General holds 328 tablets (24.4 days on hand at 13.5 tablets per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA records show Zydus Lifesciences Limited FEI 3002984011 received OAI classifications on 2011-02-03, 2014-09-05, and 2019-05-03 with associated Warning Letters on 2011-06-21, 2015-12-23, and 2019-10-29. FEI 3005430968 received a Warning Letter on 2026-06-02. FEI 3005430968 last inspection was NAI on 2020-03-09. FEI 3002984011 last inspection was VAI on 2022-08-05.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately two to three weeks. No FDA shortage listing exists. Historical and recent FDA inspection actions at Zydus facilities warrant proactive sourcing review.

Recommended actions:
1. Evaluate and qualify Ajanta Pharma USA Inc. as an alternate source; requires buyer approval.
2. Evaluate and qualify Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. as an alternate source; requires buyer approval.
3. Evaluate and qualify Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited as an alternate source; requires buyer approval.
4. Evaluate and qualify Amneal Pharmaceuticals NY LLC as an alternate source; requires buyer approval.
5. Evaluate and qualify Apotex Corp. as an alternate source; requires buyer approval.
6. Present qualified alternate options to P&T committee for formulary review; requires committee approval.

Not recommended: No clinical dosing changes or therapeutic substitutions at this time.
